properties.label: Ribbon-led editorial stage
properties.text: Sweep an oversized folded ribbon through a warm neutral stage beside or above a compact editorial title. Let its silhouette and negative space dominate while secondary captions and a pause control stay small.

properties.label: Continuous folded ribbon
properties.text: Model one continuous ribbon with smooth curvature, visible thickness and distinct front and back lighting.

properties.label: View-dependent thin-film metal
properties.text: Place thin-film metallic color on a pearl-paper ground. Iridescent hue follows angle and reflection through bright edges and darker folds rather than a static rainbow painted over a flat blob.

properties.label: Slow reflective rotation
properties.text: Use slow rotation to reveal the material, with immediate pause. Interactive motion uses view-dependent physical shading and GPU fallback uses a visually matched poster.

properties.label: Distance silhouette check
properties.text: Check the silhouette at a distance and fold detail close up.

properties.label: Continuous finish check
properties.text: Reject visible faceting, clipped ribbon ends and overexposed white regions that erase the material.
